_meta.v2Note: Adds frontierRules.momentumMarginMilli (world-map W34 momentum, owner decision 2026-08-31). A rule that would send an entity somewhere other than where this faction's own last order sent it must beat the standing choice by this margin, in per-mille of the standing score -- hysteresis, which is what damps the defend/expand oscillation a bare bonus term cannot. 250 = 25% is a starting value, not a measured one: it is the number a balance pass moves first.
